verdict.rationale: Context.dev publishes a structured API reference with per-endpoint pages, including brand, styleguide, people enrich, news search, batches and answers. A machine-readable OpenAPI spec is live at docs.context.dev/openapi.json, which could feed interactive tooling. However, no evidence shows the reference itself is interactive or offers runnable 'try it' examples. Missing for 10: an evidenced interactive playground or try-it console, runnable code examples within the reference pages, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the interactive experience.
